items.eaAreaName: Solent and South Downs
items.message: River levels are high in the Eastern Yar but are slowly falling. Flooding will be affecting low lying land, roads, cycle tracks and footpaths close to the river. Flooding of Golf Links Road and Moreton Common Road will continue throughout the day 21/11/2026. Ditches around Fort Holiday Park will struggle to drain while river levels are high. Only a small amount of rain is forecast over today 21/11/2026. River levels and flood risk will continue to reduce in Alverstone and Sandown over the next 24 hours. On Sunday 22/11/2026 up to 15mm of rain is forecast, if this affects the Eastern Yar river levels will rise again. We are monitoring rainfall and river levels and will ensure the river is kept free of reported blockages. Consider activating any flood protection products you may have. Including in Alverstone. This message will be updated by 13:00 22/11/2026.

items.description: The tidal Rivers Bure, Ant and Thurne
items.eaAreaName: East Anglia
items.message: Flooding is possible today, Saturday 21st November, and for the next few days. This is due to tide locking, where high tides restrict normal drainage of the river out to sea. We expect to see high water levels around Potter Heigham, Wroxham boat yards and Ferry Road in Horning. Levels can take several hours to peak compared to published tide tables. We are closely monitoring the situation. Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water. This message will be updated by 10am on Sunday 22nd November, or as the situation changes.
